note: Community recreation park and campground in Granum, around a pond stocked with trout each spring (a licence is needed; swimming beach on the north side), with a walking path, disc golf, ball diamonds, horseshoes, volleyball, an off-leash dog area and a rentable camp kitchen and hall. --Claude
summary: Confirmed rates C$50 (30 A w/s) / C$60 (50 A w/s), 54 RV sites with 25 pull-throughs, open May 1 to October, phone reservations, wifi and coin laundry on the park's own pages. Wrote fees, sites, hookups (electric 50 added), season (manual, closing month only), booking (phone; the note's 'Campspot' is not on the park's site), facilities; note rewritten without the field values. max_rig_ft 60 (from note prose) left alone: no park page states it.
flags: OWNERSHIP (question, stored local): the stored note/inclusion name the non-profit 'Granum Park Society' as operator; under the Alberta rule a non-profit society is private, but the park sits on what looks like community land beside the school, and the site's own masthead now says Granum is 'Formerly the "Smallest Town in Alberta"' (no longer a town). None of the park pages names the operator or landowner. Kept local; reviewer to decide whether the society operating it on municipal land makes it local (Lions/Rotary precedent) or private.
BOOKING: the stored note said 'Reservations by phone/Campspot'; the contact page says only 'Please call for Reservations 403-687-3830' and links no booking engine. Written platform 'phone'.

PRESENCE/PHONE: Google Maps 'Granview Recreation Park' 4.4 from 137 reviews, phone 403-687-3830 (matches stored and the contact page). WEBSITE https://visitgranum.com/camp/ answered 200 (the /camp/sites/, /camp/contact/, /camp/facilities-amenities/ pages too).
PRICE GATE: C$50 base (30 A w/s), under C$69.

WATERFRONT (stored not waterfront - confirmed): the stocked pond is ~1 ha in the middle of the park; the north loop (pin) is ~100 m from it past a road and the playground, and the south pull-through loop ~60 m past the ring road and walking path. The west row along the park road is ~40-60 m from the pond basin across the road and path. A small stocked pond with no site on its bank: not waterfront.
PIN (49.87140,-113.51700): on the north RV loop on imagery; Google's 49.87030,-113.51626 is mid-park by the pond. No move.
